title: Coconut oleosomes as a sustainable ingredient for food emulsion systems
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00112A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
A. A. Anoop, P. M. Ramees, K. V. Ragavan
Oleosomes extracted from virgin coconut meal were used to develop a stable vegan mayonnaise. The process offers a clean-label alternative to conventional emulsifiers and supports the sustainable use of food processing by-products.
